actions.name: send_email
actions.description: Send an email to one or more recipients via Emailit.

actions.name: get_email
actions.description: Get one sent or received email with its status, headers, body and attachment list.

actions.name: list_emails
actions.description: Search sent or received emails, newest first (last 14 days unless you set dates).

actions.name: update_scheduled_email
actions.description: Change the send time of a scheduled email.

actions.name: cancel_email
actions.description: Cancel an email that is scheduled, queued or waiting to retry.

actions.name: retry_email
actions.description: Send a bounced, failed, suppressed or held email again as a new email.

actions.name: forward_email
actions.description: Send a copy of a sent email to new recipients.

actions.name: list_domains
actions.description: List the sending domains of the workspace with their verification status.

actions.name: get_domain
actions.description: Get a sending domain with its verification status and the DNS records to publish.

actions.name: verify_domain
actions.description: Re-check a sending domain's DNS records now and update its verification status.

actions.name: list_audiences
actions.description: List the audiences (subscriber lists) of the workspace.

actions.name: add_subscriber
actions.description: Add an email address to an audience, creating the contact if needed.

actions.name: update_subscriber
actions.description: Subscribe or unsubscribe someone from an audience, or change their name.

actions.name: remove_subscriber
actions.description: Delete someone's membership in an audience. The contact is kept.

actions.name: find_contact
actions.description: Look up a contact by email address or contact ID.

actions.name: create_or_update_contact
actions.description: Create a contact, or update the existing contact with the same email.

actions.name: add_suppression
actions.description: Stop Emailit from sending to an address, permanently or until a date.

actions.name: remove_suppression
actions.description: Remove a suppression so Emailit can send to the address again.

actions.name: verify_email_address
actions.description: Check whether an address is valid and safe to send to. Costs 5 credits per check.

actions.name: list_templates
actions.description: List the published email templates of the workspace.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
